# Install and import some default libraries

!pip install pymatgen > /dev/null 2>&1  # Suppress installation informational messages
from pymatgen.core.structure import Structure
from pymatgen.io.cif import CifParser

# Run CGCNN from python script (at least 30 minutes)

!python main.py /content/drive/MyDrive/work_cgcnn/cgcnn-master/data/hMOF_Database --task classification --epochs 100 --train-ratio 0.8 --val-ratio 0.1 --test-ratio 0.1 --Additional_feat_num 5 --Class_num 4

# Run CGCNN from python script extracting data from a zipped file
# This will take longer time (at least an hour) depending on your training
# Make sure the location of the data is within the cgcnn. Period!

!python mainz.py data hMOF_cifs --task classification --epochs 100 --train-ratio 0.8 --val-ratio 0.1 --test-ratio 0.1 --Additional_feat_num 5 --Class_num 4

# Resume From checkpoints
!python mainz.py data hMOF_cifs --task classification --epochs 100 --train-ratio 0.8 --val-ratio 0.1 --test-ratio 0.1 --Additional_feat_num 5 --Class_num 4 --resume /content/drive/MyDrive/work_cgcnn/KK_Multiclass_cgcnn_1/checkpoint.pth.tar --disable-cuda
